name: Effect: Become as Shadow

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Granted by Become as Shadow

You gain the incorporeal trait and resistance 10 to all damage except force, spirit, and damage from Strikes with weapons with the ghost touch property; double this resistance against non-magical damage. However, whenever you are in an area of bright light, you are Enfeebled 3 and Off-Guard
